record.question: In 2022, India overtook United Kingdom to become the ________ largest economy in the world.
record.explanation: Answer C: fifth. In 2022 India became the world’s fifth-largest economy by nominal GDP, overtaking the UK. Reference: https://www.imf.org/en/Blogs/Articles/2022/12/01/blog-india-overtakes-uk-to-become-worlds-fifth-largest-economy. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
